Payments outage: postmortem

Card payments failed for four hours after a gateway certificate expired. No money was lost.

Timeline

09:12The gateway certificate expired.
09:20Declines rose; the on-call engineer was paged.
13:05A renewed certificate went out; payments recovered.

Remediation

  • Alert a month before any certificate expires. Owner: platform team.
  • Renew certificates automatically. Owner: payments team.
